name: ProductionKind - Default (seed v2)
description: A production kind of the catalogue (production engine P3, #86): area model, yield sources, resource category, workers and default storages. Its ten levels are created with it and edited on their own form.

steps.description: Name the kind and say where its resources come from.

fields.label: Name
fields.description: Shown in the web app and in game menus, e.g. "Quarry". Unique.

fields.label: Description
fields.description: A line about what the kind produces, for admins and players.

fields.label: Icon
fields.description: A Minecraft material name for menus, e.g. IRON_PICKAXE. Optional.

fields.label: Area model
fields.description: Where the resources come from (used by the yield areas, P4): BorderedField (a farm field), ExclusiveVolume (a quarry or mine), SharedRadius (a logger or fishery), Pasture (animals) or HuntingGround (hunters, not in V1).

fields.label: Exclusive areas
fields.description: Areas of this kind may not overlap each other. Empty on create = from the area model (fields, volumes and pastures are exclusive).

fields.label: Resource category
fields.description: What weather and category modifiers target: crops, wood, stone, ore, fish, flowers or animals. A production line can override it.

fields.label: Active
fields.description: Inactive kinds stay on their structures but are not offered for new ones (the web app filters on it).

steps.description: Which yield sources a structure of this kind may use (P3 builds Configured; Derived and Hybrid come with the yield areas) and how many workers it gets.

fields.label: Allows Derived
fields.description: Rates from a survey of the structure's area (P4).

fields.label: Allows Configured
fields.description: Rates an admin enters on the production lines.

fields.label: Allows Hybrid
fields.description: The survey plus admin pins, exclusions and scales; the default yield source (P-D1).

fields.label: Default workers
fields.description: Producer workers a new structure of this kind gets (0-100, default 2). Output scales with the workers present.

fields.label: Cycle variation
fields.description: An optional ±10% variation per cycle (P-D9), used with byproducts from P4. Stored now.

steps.description: Storages a new structure of this kind gets next to its Output storage.

fields.label: Default storages
fields.description: A JSON list, e.g. [{"purpose":"Input","name":"inputs","maxUnits":500}]. Purposes: General, Input, Delivery, Merchandise (Output is always created). maxUnits is optional (empty = no cap). Leave empty for only the Output storage.

steps.description: What the plugin's survey counts and the primary outputs' factor (yield areas P4, #138). The yield table and the primary outputs are lists in the kind's API body (the web app's kind editor, #680).

fields.label: Survey profile
fields.description: A JSON object the game server's survey reads, e.g. {"unitTypes":["TREE","SAPLING"]}. A change raises the profile version.

fields.label: Primary multiplier
fields.description: The factor the kind's primary outputs get on Derived and Hybrid lines (a coal mine's coal). 0 to 100, default 1.5.
